damage.note: a unit pressed on the environment or another unit above part_force_N for `ticks` consecutive 10 ms ticks (0.2 s) is a safety violation (the normal forces summed per unit and body it presses on; the gripper's pads on a unit do not count)

layout.note: the episode's physical draws: the stand +-10 mm (never turned); every unit moved by up to xy_m and turned about the vertical by up to yaw_deg around its place in the shop's layout of the kit, on the face that layout gives it (the lower legs at the side edges: edge_along_m along, edge_across_m across the edge, edge_yaw_deg); the output pulleys at their index +-2 deg

note: the cell's configuration as far as it is public (the camera mounts and the shop's layout of the kit are not)

reach_check.note: every episode's layout is checked on the built cell: every shoulder, support and upper leg can be picked from above where it lies and every lower leg's knee can be made there; else the layout is drawn again
